text: Members will complete the work planning process. Staff from the Gender Equity Unit will present on the top three priority areas which will determine the focus of work for the remainder of the Committee’s term.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Manager, Gender Equity Unit, People and Equity amend the revised list of priority issues based on the feedback from the Committee so it reads as follows: 1. Housing and Shelters 2. Public Health (Mental Health) 3. Employment, Social Supports & Poverty Reduction 4. Community Safety 5. Seniors in Long-Term Care
